_description: LOD-Climate Rhythm empirical validation summary (docs/102 item 7): Pearson correlation of the joint-world cumulative stack deltaLOD (4 flags + Core-mantle swing) against Bond 2001 North-Atlantic IRD over the validated window, out-of-sample (the stack was fit against the Stephenson 2016 deltaT residual, not any climate proxy); GISP2 shown for comparison; sign-convention hits on the five named in-window events (Maunder Minimum misses). SHIPPED AS 'OPEN CORRESPONDENCE, NOT VALIDATION' — the correlation fails every formal null test (docs/103); the framework's own docs carry that caveat and any consumer of these numbers must too. Consumed by the model-values registry (LOD-climate keys).
